facts.claim: Arjun wrote to the partners' address at lattice-capital.test that Nimbus Labs is raising a seed round and asked for a short meeting.
The file's numbers for that address record that our mail to it bounced the same morning it was sent.
Arjun's mail is the file's only touch.
The engine holds a situation typed for an investor on this file, in the fundraising domain, on the engine's default window.
The file's history records no earlier verdict or outcome.

inferences.claim: Lattice never received the pitch, so the fund has not seen the raise at all; the quiet in this file says nothing about the fund's interest.
The move is ours again, whatever the file's own line on whose move it is: the pitch must go to an address that works.
A bounce within the hour points at the address, not at the fund.

patterns.claim: There is no history to read a pattern from: the file has no earlier verdict or outcome, and no playbook is attached while the brief names no kind of work for it.

hypotheses.proposition: The address was mistyped, or the fund writes from a different domain.
hypotheses.needs: The fund's correct contact address, from its own site or from whoever pointed Arjun to it.

hypotheses.proposition: A resend to a working address would reach a partner who reads it.
hypotheses.needs: A delivered resend and the fund's answer.

unknowns.question: Why the mail bounced.
unknowns.relevance: A wrong address is fixed by resending; a fund that has closed that address needs another route, such as an introduction.

unknowns.question: Whether other mails of the seed raise bounced too.
unknowns.relevance: If several did, the outreach list itself needs checking, not just this address.

unknowns.question: Who at Lattice is the right person to write to.
unknowns.relevance: A named partner, or a warm introduction, does better than a generic partners' address.

frames.primary: Arjun's seed-round pitch to Lattice never arrived — the mail bounced — so the fund has not seen the raise, and the next move is ours.
rivals: A temporary delivery failure on the fund's side, where the same address would work on a resend.
A fund no longer reachable at that domain, where the path is another address or an introduction.

proposed_kind.why: Arjun wrote to the fund's partners that Nimbus Labs is raising its seed round and asked for a meeting: this file is a fund in the raise.

expected_vs_actual.expected: Without a playbook, the brief sets the expectation: a pitch to a fund in the seed raise is delivered and read, and the fund answers or stays quiet on its own.
expected_vs_actual.actual: The pitch bounced the same morning it was sent, so the fund never received it; the file holds nothing since.

scenarios.do_nothing: The file reads as a fund that went quiet when in fact it never saw the pitch, and Lattice drops out of the raise unnoticed.
scenarios.act: Finding the right address and resending puts the pitch in front of Lattice's partners for the first time.
scenarios.best: A resend to a working address reaches a partner, who agrees to a meeting.
scenarios.worst: The resend bounces too, or lands in a generic inbox nobody reads, and the fund is lost to the raise without anyone deciding it.
signals_to_watch: A second bounce on the resend
A delivered resend answered by a partner
Other bounces among the raise's outreach

reasons: A fund in the seed raise, the brief's first goal, never received the pitch.
Nothing is lost yet that a resend to the right address cannot recover.
The file's own line says the move is theirs, so the gap is easy to miss.

next_move.what: Find Lattice's correct address, a named partner if possible, and resend the seed-round note to it

parsed.alternative: If no working address can be found, ask someone who knows the fund for an introduction to a partner.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Do not wait on Lattice: it has nothing to answer. After a delivered resend, give the fund the usual time a first contact takes; stop if the resend bounces too and no other route exists.
parsed.done_when: A resend reaches Lattice without a bounce, at an address that gets to a partner.
parsed.draft: Hi Lattice team, Nimbus Labs is raising its seed round — we're building an AI chief of staff for founders. Could we find twenty minutes to talk? Arjun
